quizPlan.instructions: Listen to each question and choose the silly mix-up.

interaction.onCorrect: Give kind, encouraging feedback and explain the answer simply.
interaction.onIncorrect: Invite the child to try again without losing a turn or points.

screens.prompt: Which sentence is the silly mix-up?

choices.text: A fish rides a bicycle to school.

screens.correctFeedback: You found the silly mix-up! Fish swim; they don't ride bikes.
screens.hint: Think about how a fish moves around.

screens.prompt: What does not belong in a bird picture?
screens.correctFeedback: That's right! Birds have feathers and beaks, not wheels.
screens.hint: Look for the thing a bird would not have on its body.

screens.prompt: It's raining. Which thing will not help you stay dry?
screens.correctFeedback: Good spotting! A pillow is for resting, not for keeping dry in the rain.
screens.hint: Which thing is usually for resting your head?

choices.text: A clock eats an apple for lunch.

screens.correctFeedback: You got it! A clock can tell time, but it doesn't eat lunch.

screens.prompt: Which one is the silly mix-up?

choices.text: A plant needs water to grow.
A plant can grow in sunlight.
A plant wears shoes on its feet.

screens.correctFeedback: That's the mix-up! Plants grow roots, not feet for shoes.
screens.hint: Think about what plants have instead of feet.
screens.completionMessage: You found all the silly mix-ups!
